parts:
You can create a separate dataframe with your labels/annotations, and that dataframe will have to have the same levels as the facets. Something like the following:

ggplot()+
geom_point(data=df, aes(x=x, y=y, color=groupingvar1)+
geom_text(data=label.df, aes(x=-Inf, y=-Inf)+
facet_wrap(.~groupingvar2)

B

On Fri, Oct 19, 2012 at 1:41 PM, boblatest <bobl...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hello,

is it possible to add annotation (in this case: a text) on top of a faceted plot, reaching across several facets? I've skimmed the documentation about adding grid grobs to ggplots, but all of these function require coordinates in the ggplot data context. What I need is much more general, the position of my annotation is in no way related to ggplot grobs or the underlying data.

Thanks,
robert
